_metadata.description: Service surface boundary: dual-mount validation service, agent-readable maturity assessment, and finding-code↔maturity mapping.

requirements.title: Dual-mount native and shared validation service
requirements.description: structure-health mounts both a native structure-health/v1 ValidationService (rich detail in native_detail) and the shared scenario-validation/v1 ScenarioValidationServiceHandler, so Test Genie can delegate the structure phase while humans/agents get the richer native response from the same engine.

validation.notes: handlers/validation/handler_test.go proves both the native and shared mounts return a well-formed response for the same target.

requirements.title: Agent-readable maturity assessment
requirements.description: Responses carry stable finding codes, severity, evidence, location, remediation, current and next Structure Health local maturity (L0–L4), and the blocking findings for the next level, built through packages/maturity-go/assessment.

validation.notes: End-to-end handler/main tests assert deterministic finding codes and current/next level transitions in the assessment.

requirements.title: Every finding code maps in the maturity ladder
requirements.description: Every finding code the validator can emit is mapped in .vrooli/maturity.json with a local level impact, global impact, dimension, and default severity; severity owns pass/fail (ERROR/BLOCKER fail the phase).

validation.notes: Rules/assessment tests assert each emitted code resolves in the loaded maturity spec; ERROR-severity findings gate local maturity.
